title: Open Mic & Jam @ The Wormhole
event_description: Savannah's favorite open mic and jam session welcoming bands and singer-songwriters of all genres. Full backline provided including drums and keys with many instruments available. Play your own songs or jam with others.
backline: Full backline (drums keys guitar bass). Many instruments available.
event_venue_information:
About The Wormhole Music Club and Bar

The Wormhole Music Venue and Neighborhood Pub is located in the Starland Design District of Savannah. This unique venue has been serving the community for over 10 years combining a neighborhood watering hole atmosphere with a first-rate concert venue.

Venue Features

The venue offers billiards darts arcades pinball and classic video games including NES Sega and Nintendo 64 all available to play for free. The full kitchen stays open until 2:45 AM serving hot pressed paninis grilled wraps half-pound burgers and more made with real fresh ingredients.

Music and Events

The Wormhole hosts a diverse array of musical performances from metal to bluegrass electronica to square dancing. The venue has welcomed headlining acts like Dick Dale HELMET Band of Horses Jonathan Richman and Papadosio. They also host stand-up comedy featuring performers including Dave Chappelle David Spade and Doug Stanhope.

Open Mic Details

The Monday night open mic runs from 8PM to 2:30AM and has been voted Best Open Mic by Connect Savannah. Solo acts get 10-15 minute sets while bands get 15 minutes with the option to sign up again non-consecutively. The venue is 18+ and provides a welcoming stage for newly formed bands professionals working on new material musicians looking to jam touring bands and anyone wanting to be part of Savannah's music scene.

title: Open Mic @ 208 Wine Bar
event_description: Popular Thursday night open mic hosted by Savannah artist Brandi Olenyik featuring a rotating lineup of local musicians. Each week brings intimate solo sets and surprising collaborations in a cozy wine bar setting.
event_venue_information:
About 208 Wine Bar

208 Wine Bar is nestled above River Street in a historic building dating to 1859 built by John Stoddard for his thriving cotton trade. The venue brings cozy elegance and creative energy to downtown Savannah with over 50 wines by the glass flight or bottle.

Atmosphere and Setting

Located on Upper Factors Walk just behind River Street this intimate wine bar offers an upscale yet cozy escape. Large windows provide picturesque views of ships arriving and departing on the Savannah River creating a serene atmosphere perfect for conversation and relaxation.

Music Programming

The venue hosts open mic nights every Thursday from 6:30-8:30 PM and live music performances every other Saturday. The intimate setting seats up to 45 adults creating a warm personal atmosphere where every performance feels special. Known for its welcoming vibe where locals gather stories are shared and the creative energy is always charged.

Wine Selection

The carefully curated wine list features eclectic selections from around the globe including unique wine flights like Tour de France and selections from India. The knowledgeable staff led by owner Christina provides expert guidance in wine selection. The venue recently expanded to include cocktails becoming 208 Wine Bar and Cocktail Lounge.

title: Open Mic @ Warehouse Bar & Grille
event_description: Tuesday night open mic on River Street in downtown Savannah hosted by blues singer-songwriter and guitarist Hitman. Features blues alternative classic rock hard rock funk country and more genres.
event_venue_information:
About Warehouse Bar & Grille

The Warehouse Bar & Grille is located directly on River Street in the heart of downtown Savannah's historic waterfront district. This popular riverside venue combines casual dining with live music in an authentic warehouse setting.

Music Scene

Every Tuesday night features open mic hosted by blues guitarist and singer-songwriter Brett 'Hitman' Barnard from 8 PM to 11 PM. The event welcomes musicians playing blues alternative classic rock hard rock funk honky-tonk country pop psychedelic and rock. The venue accepts credit cards and provides a relaxed atmosphere for performers and audience members.

Location and Atmosphere

Situated at 18 E River St the venue offers the quintessential Savannah River Street experience with cobblestone streets historic architecture and views of the Savannah River. The casual bar and grille atmosphere makes it accessible for both locals and tourists looking to experience live music in downtown Savannah.

title: Open Mic @ El Rocko Lounge
event_description: Weekly Tuesday night open mic where musicians can bring their instruments and jam all night. No cover charge in a retro-themed downtown lounge known for live entertainment and late-night dancing.
event_venue_information:
About El Rocko Lounge

El Rocko Lounge is a retro-themed cocktail lounge located on Whitaker Street in downtown Savannah near City Market and River Street. Established in 2016 this venue has become known as Savannah's destination for live entertainment.

Venue Atmosphere

The lounge features classy retro decor with a capacity of 150 people. Known for its frozen cocktails and wide draft beer selection the venue offers happy hour specials and maintains a vibrant late-night atmosphere. The space is designed for dancing and socializing with good acoustics for live performances.

Music and Entertainment

El Rocko hosts weekly rock hip hop and DJ sets along with comedy performances. Thursday through Saturday the venue features live music from 9 PM to 1 AM. The Tuesday open mic night welcomes all musicians to bring their instruments and participate with no cover charge. The venue is 21+ and open from 5 PM to 3 AM Monday through Saturday.

Bar Features

The bartenders are known for their skill and charm creating excellent cocktails and maintaining an energetic friendly vibe. The venue provides bike parking street parking and accepts credit cards. Located conveniently in the heart of downtown it's an ideal spot for groups looking for good music and dancing.

title: Open Mic @ Mint to Be Mojito
event_description: Sunday evening open mic hosted by R&B soul and pop singer-songwriter Jacob Evans. Features rotating local talent in an intimate Latin-themed bar known for handcrafted mojitos and Latin bites.
venue_name: Mint to Be Mojito Bar and Bites
event_venue_information:
About Mint to Be Mojito Bar and Bites

Mint to Be Mojito Bar and Bites is tucked away in a quiet corner of downtown Savannah at 12 W State St. This Latin-inspired establishment specializes in handcrafted mojitos and authentic Latin bites creating a vibrant welcoming atmosphere.

Food and Drink

The bar focuses specifically on the art of the perfect mojito with fresh fruit hand-muddled and made to order. Flavors include classic strawberry coconut passionfruit pineapple and seasonal varieties. Non-alcoholic mojitos are also available. The food menu showcases authentic Latin-inspired bites including empanadas arepas tamales papa rellenas and Cuban sandwiches all made with fresh quality ingredients.

La Aparicion Speakeasy

Behind a hidden door accessed through the private bathroom is La Aparicion a secret speakeasy lounge. This upscale space features vibey decor an antique-trendy forest aesthetic and creative cocktails served with little lights for a fun experience. The speakeasy is available for private events and cocktail classes teaching Latin American craft cocktail techniques.

Music and Atmosphere

Sunday evenings from 6-9 PM feature open mic hosted by Jacob Evans known for his soulful pop and R&B style. Latin music plays throughout creating an energetic warm environment. The venue accepts credit cards offers bike and street parking and is open seven days a week with extended hours on weekends.

title: Open Mic/Talent Showcase @ The Sentient Bean
event_description: Family-friendly open mic on 1st and 3rd Tuesdays welcoming poetry music singing drag and performance art. An anything-goes showcase emphasizing new original thoughtful work in an intimate listening room.
event_venue_information:
About The Sentient Bean

The Sentient Bean is an independently owned cafe and vegetarian restaurant located directly across from Forsyth Park in the heart of Savannah. More than just a coffeehouse it's a gathering space dedicated to conscious consumption and community activism.

Food and Beverages

The cafe serves fair trade organic coffee and espresso drinks with a menu featuring organic and locally sourced ingredients often purchased directly from farmers. Homemade baked goods include whole wheat and gluten-free options. Sunday brunch runs from 9 AM to 12 PM. The venue has been voted Best Coffeehouse Best Vegetarian Restaurant Best Indie Film Venue and Best Green Business by Connect Savannah readers.

Music and Events

Most evenings the dining room converts into an intimate listening room hosting live music open mics films and community forums. The space features vaulted 22-foot wood ceilings a modest 5x7 ft stage and can seat up to 50 people or accommodate 70 standing. The acoustics favor acoustic music but the venue welcomes diverse genres poetry comedy burlesque small-scale theater drag and film showings.

Open Mic Details

Tongue open mouth and music night happens every 1st and 3rd Tuesday. Sign-up begins at 6:30 PM with the show starting at 7 PM. The event is free open to all and family-friendly emphasizing new original thoughtful work. Anything goes from poetry and music to singing drag and performance art making it a true community talent showcase.

Atmosphere

The Sentient Bean buzzes with positive energy featuring eclectic decor high ceilings and an open layout that fosters creativity. Happy hour runs daily from 5-9 PM with $5 wine and $3 beer. The community-focused space attracts locals and visitors seeking a welcoming inclusive environment.
